scope: The generated-project gate defines a Node monorepo corner that installs, formats, checks architecture, typechecks, and lints when executed.
Focused template generation covers both Bun and Node @repo/modules manifests and ambient type selections.
limitations: This record maps committed verification contracts; it is not a captured gate result.
A current bun run test:generated -- --only next-monorepo-node result is required before claiming installed generated-project compatibility.

scope: The packed-CLI contract installs the exact Bun-packed tarball, generates Bun and Node monorepos with --no-install, and inspects the Node @repo/modules manifest and tsconfig.
limitations: This record maps a committed packed-CLI test contract; it is not a captured gate result.
The packed-CLI contract does not install, typecheck, build, start, or exercise the generated application under Node.
